news.title: Gopal Iron & Steels Co. (Gujarat) Ltd. Approves Resignation of Mr. Mukesh Jani as the Non-Executive Independent Director, Effective March 3, 2026
news.body: Gopal Iron & Steels Co. (Gujarat) Ltd. approved the resignation of Mr. Mukesh Jani as the Non-Executive Independent Director of the company, effective March 3, 2026. Mr. Mukesh Jani holds directorships in other entities: NA. Reason for Change: Due to his preoccupation and other personal commitments he is unable to continue as an Independent Director in the Company.

news.title: Gopal Iron & Steel Co. (Gujarat) Limited Announces Resignation of Kundanben Bhaveshbhai Patel as Managing Director, Effective March 3, 2026
news.body: Gopal Iron & Steel Co. (Gujarat) Limited at its board meeting held on March 3, 2026, approved the resignation of Mrs. Kundanben Bhaveshbhai Patel as the Managing Director of the company. Date of Cessation is March 3, 2026. Reason for Change: Due to her preoccupation and other personal commitments she is unable to continue as the managing Director in the Company. Mrs. Kundanben Bhaveshbhai Patel holds directorships in the following other entities: Hari Gopal Steels & Metals Private Limited.

news.title: Gopal Iron & Steel Co. (Gujarat) Limited Approves Chief Financial Officer Changes, Effective March 3, 2026
news.body: Gopal Iron & Steel Co. (Gujarat) Limited at its board meeting held on March 3, 2026, approved appointment of Mr. Harshil Chandreshbhai Patni as the Chief Financial Officer of the Company. Date of appointment is March 3, 2026. An operations and finance professional with demonstrated expertise in compliance, financial management, and performance optimization. Skilled in driving strategic initiatives, ensuring regulatory adherence, and enhancing organizational efficiency to support sustainable growth. The company approved resignation of Mr. Baldevbhai Patel, from the post of Chief Financial Officer of the company. Date of Cessation is March 3, 2026. Reason for Change: Due to his preoccupation and other personal commitments he is unable to continue as a CFO in the Company.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.32 loss per share (vs ₹0.05 profit in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.32 loss per share (down from ₹0.05 profit in 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹1.57m (down ₹1.81m from profit in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 95 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 2 experienced directors. 1 highly experienced director. Independent Director Mukesh Jani was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2021. The company’s insufficient board refreshment is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Insider recently sold ₹622k worth of stock
news.body: On the 20th of November, Shardaben Patel sold around 101k shares on-market at roughly ₹6.17 per share. This transaction amounted to 100% of their direct individual holding at the time of the trade. This was the largest sale by an insider in the last 3 months. Insiders have been net sellers, collectively disposing of ₹802k more than they bought in the last 12 months.
